_provenance.formula: z = (raw prediction - arithmetic mean) / population standard deviation
_provenance.weighting: equal weight per successfully annotated clip

source_manifest.sampling: All local S10 t0; all packed Gemini performances at frozen snapshot; Emilia language-balanced random shard quotas then uniform rows
source_manifest.emilia_s10_overlap: Excluded exact S10 UIDs from Emilia selection
source_manifest.snapshot_update: Included ten additional successfully packed reviewed ordinary acting scenes before any annotation job began.

_provenance.interpretation: Reference-relative model deviation; not an emotion probability or population-unbiased survey
_provenance.pleasantness_target: audiobox:CE; VoiceNet ESTH remains in raw outputs only
_provenance.event_boundary_rule: Clamp sub-sample end-time rounding to stored float32 duration in derived sidecars; preserve original end_s in end_s_before_boundary_clamp
